6,360 likes, 153 comments - sanjeevkapoor on October 4, 2026: "When I look back at these 34 beautiful years, I realise how much has changed since we first started this journey. We’ve built a family, followed our dreams, taken on new responsibilities and grown through every experience life has brought our way. There have been moments of joy, moments that tested us and countless ordinary days that, over the years, have become some of my favourite memories. What makes it all the more special is knowing that I’ve had you to share this life with.

Here’s to everything we’ve shared, everything we’ve learnt and all the beautiful moments still waiting for us. Happy Anniversary. ❤️ @alyonakapoor 

#anniversary #sanjeevkapoor #alyonakapoor".
